div.div:
مُقَصِّبٌ (tropical:) One who wins, or acquires, the canes of the contest for victory (in racing يُحْرِزُ قَصَبَ السِّبَاقِ, A, O, K, TA, in the CK قَصَبَاتِ السِّباقِ) [i. e. in horse-racing]: and (tropical:) a fleet horse, that outstrips others. (A.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) Milk upon which the froth is thick. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
